facts.content: Patient denies hearing-related pain, discharge, or fever.
Patient has no chest pain or palpitations.
Left-sided hearing loss for 6 weeks with intermittent tinnitus and mild disequilibrium, but no pain, discharge, or fever; need to rule out cerumen impaction versus middle/inner ear pathology.
